sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 76.6 "Ethernet functional description: PHY interfaces" in chapter 76 (Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4094.
sections.section_content:
The Ethernet peripheral support several PHY interfaces. The root interface is the MII/GMII
one. All other interfaces are derived from it as shown in Figure1045.
[Figure 1045. Supported PHY interfaces]
This section describes the SMA module used for PHY control and different PHY interfaces.
It contains the following sections:
• Station management agent (SMA)
• Media independent interface (MII)
• Reduced media independent interface (RMII)
• Reduced gigabit media independent interface (RGMII)
